description: Read-only Sui blockchain analytics: 47 tools, protocol-aware tx decoding, no API keys or wallet.
name: io.github.0xfreak0/sui-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Default network when a tool call doesn't pass one. Every tool also takes a per-call network argument.
environmentVariables.name: SUI_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Override the gRPC fullnode endpoint for the default network only.
environmentVariables.name: SUI_FULLNODE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the GraphQL endpoint for the default network only.
environmentVariables.name: SUI_GRAPHQL_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a locally built Revela move-decompiler binary. Only decompile_module needs it.
environmentVariables.name: SUI_DECOMPILER_PATH

environmentVariables.description: JSON file of address attribution labels that overrides the shipped set for fund tracing.
environmentVariables.name: SUI_LABELS_FILE

title: Sui Analytics
